falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 77% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support level and invalidate the bottoming pattern thesis, suggesting continuation lower rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX elevation above 25 contradicts the HOLD signal's implied expectation of volatility compression; the August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking then rapidly declining, so persistent elevated fear would prove this is not a similar bottoming formation but rather a breakdown into risk-off

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This combination signals flight-to-safety with equity weakness, invalidating the macro bottom call which requires either yields stable/rising with growth optimism OR yields falling with equity strength (Fed pivot scenario); stagflationary or recessionary yield collapse with falling stocks breaks the pattern logic entirely

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
